blocks.body:
Shrink and unshrink tools in record time while saving energy and protecting the tooling: You get all these benefits with the »powerShrink« inductive shrinking system. With the »powerShrink« series of devices, you can boost the efficiency of your production.

»actbyLight« guides you safely through the shrinking process and includes the »shrinkbyLight« coil function, the LED control on the induction coil, and the »coolbyLight« LED user guidance on the cooling system.

blocks.body:
With ZOLLER’s »powerShrink«, you save time, reduce your electricity costs, and extend the life of your shrink fit holders thanks to the perfect interplay of electronics, software, and mechanics, combined with a well-designed, reliable shrink process.

30% energy savings

blocks.title: 30% energy savings
blocks.text:
ZOLLER induction technology allows you to heat your shrink fit holders optimally. For you, this means: consistent heating across the entire clamping range and only for as long as necessary. This results in short heating and cooling times, short cycle times, reduced wear on the holders, and a longer lifetime.

A particular advantage of »powerShrink«—through which ZOLLER contributes to sustainable manufacturing practices—is the energy savings of up to 30% compared to the previous model. We’re especially proud of this. The heat and energy are delivered exactly where you need them to safely shrink and unshrink your tools.

blocks.header:
Tool Heat Shrink Technology

Smart Design for Maximum Efficiency
blocks.body:
A smart, well-designed highlight of »the« »powerShrink« is the ZOLLER induction coil. Two windings connected in parallel within the coil can be activated separately and controlled differently depending on the clamping diameter and length. This enables optimal energy transfer to the clamping area, accelerates the heating and cooling process, and protects your tool holders.

Coil with »varOct« shielding system Coil with shielding discs

blocks.title: When Art Hits the Mark
blocks.text:
Inspired by modern architecture and optical kinematics, ZOLLER’s Research and Development department has created a masterpiece. The ZOLLER induction coil with the »varOct« shielding system ensures maximum efficiency and ergonomics in the shrink-wrapping process.

8 ferrite elements

Ingeniously conceived. Perfectly constructed. The eight variable elements of the »varOct« coil shielding glide smoothly past one another—a design masterpiece. ZOLLER’s unique approach delivers unbeatable design and efficiency.

blocks.title: Flexibility in the blink of an eye
blocks.text:
With the ZOLLER induction coil with shielding discs, you’re choosing a simple, manual shrink-fitting process for applications with infrequent diameter changes or low variation.

Discs of different diameters ensure that the coil’s magnetic field is optimally aligned and shielded accordingly. The optionally available »shrinkbyLight« user guidance, consisting of a control LED for diameter monitoring and a status indicator for the windings, provides additional process reliability during the operation of your »powerShrink«.

blocks.body:
With »powerShrink« from ZOLLER, you can cool with maximum efficiency. The five cooling bells for standard-compliant shrink fit holders ranging from D6 mm to D32 mm ensure fast, consistent cooling thanks to their intelligent design and integrated contact cooling. Your shrink fit holders are protected, and their high concentricity is maintained.

Cooling bells Cooling bell guide ZOLLER »zStream«

blocks.title: Focused on comfort and safety
blocks.text: The right cooling bell for every requirement: Choose between the standard cooling bell or the cooling bell with »coolbyLight« user guidance for maximum safety for your operators. Both cooling bells are available with either free-moving or linear, mechanical guidance, depending on your preference.

blocks.title: Cooling Bell Guide
blocks.text: Simply hooked in or securely guided? Choose between two options for the cooling hood guide: the simple fixing mechanism or the linear guide for maximum comfort and safety.

blocks.title: The Unique Cooling Alternative
blocks.text: With the »zStream« air cooling by ZOLLER you get maximal flexibility and protection with the cooling of your tools and shrink fit tool holder, independently of their contour or diameter. Tool cutting edges are in absolutely no danger of being damaged. You require absolutely no accessories such as a cooling adapter. In addition, your shrink tools are cooled evenly along their entire length.
